summary: The methods paragraph accurately distinguishes the 155 retained source files from the 100 reachable inherited modules rebuilt before the 14 new modules. It also explains the child receipt’s generic cache wording without claiming a clean dependency rebuild. The manuscript hash matches.

checks.method: Read F29 drivers and composite/child summaries; verified both child-summary hashes, counted the manifest’s inherited sources, and inspected all module receipt statuses.
checks.observation: The manifest contains 155 A1K sources; 114 receipts report stable sources and zero exits. The driver passes its fresh base-build directory into the new-module replay. The prose therefore correctly limits retained compiled-object reliance to Lean, mathlib, and package caches, while identifying the same host/controller and absence of independent reproduction. It does not imply that all 155 inherited modules were rebuilt.
